question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In Sheet 1 of Figure 2C-13 ("A – Freeway or expressway - lane ends"), the symbol sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends (W4-2R) symbol sign. It is placed at the advance placement distance from the taper per Table 2C-3, while the optional RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) word sign with a 1000 FEET (W16-2P) plaque is shown farther upstream. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - Not directly applicable here, but where a lane ends less than the Table 2C-3 advance placement distance beyond an intersection, "the W4-2 sign may be located at the far side of the intersection (see Sheet 4 of Figure 2C-13)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows the freeway/expressway lane-ends sequence with the W4-2R symbol sign as the sign closest to the start of the taper, dimensioned by the advance placement distance from Table 2C-3, and the W9-1R (optional) with W16-2P plaque located farther upstream. [Image 5] is the full page 185 view confirming the same arrangement in Figure 2C-13, Sheet 1 of 5. [Image 3] (Figure 2C-11) shows the W4-2 symbol sign design (right-lane-ends symbol) alongside the W9-1 word sign. [Image 2] provides Table 2C-3, which governs the advance placement distance of the W4-2R from the taper. [Image 7] (Figure 3B-14) similarly depicts the W4-2R nearest the taper (at distance AP) with the W9-1R farther upstream. Citations: - Section 2C.47 Support §2 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Support §1 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Section 2C.47 Option §7 (p.186) - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Figure 2C-11 (p.182) - Table 2C-3 (p.152) - Page 226 - Page 608
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
